inner_arch.form_by_mood: It is the mood and gaze inclination of the beholder that gives Zemrude its form—from below upward (sills, curtains, fountains) or downward into gutters, grilles, fish scales, and wastepaper.
inner_arch.ontological_parity: Neither aspect of Zemrude is truer than the other (oneAspectTruer === false).
inner_arch.asymmetric_habit_gravity: Walking the same streets day after day encrusts the ill-humor of the day before at the foot of the walls, drawing the gaze down along the drainpipes until it cannot easily detach from the paving stones; the upward reverse is not impossible, but rare, while sunken eyes keep digging into cellars, foundations, and wells—hearing of upper Zemrude chiefly as fading memories recalled from below.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Vertical Gaze-Inclination & Asymmetric Habit-Ratchet Architectural Section with Procedural Flute-Whistle / Gutter-Well WebAudio
